label_zh: 医学分支宪法：全科顶级能力、只加能力
mission: Build and maintain a full-specialty, top-tier comprehensive-hospital-style medical decision-support capability stack across diagnosis, testing, imaging, pathology, evidence-based medicine, medication, treatment design, procedures, nursing, rehabilitation, genetics and longitudinal care.
coverage: all major medical specialties and subspecialties; cross-specialty and multidisciplinary clinical problems are included as capabilities, not as workflow engines
target: top-tier comprehensive hospital breadth and depth of medical decision-support capability; this is a capability target and not a claim of equivalence to in-person examination, hospital equipment or licensed clinical care

future_change_contract.rule: Future medical-branch evolution must add or improve capability records, tools or authoritative sources only. It must not add a new process, route, committee, orchestration layer or workflow framework.
